answer: Weight is paid for surviving refutation, not for holding keys. Each epoch a stranger may file one attack on a published result: a counterexample or a broken assumption. A valid attack voids it for every address that submitted it. A thousand clones share one survival record and fall to a single counterexample, however many keys signed. To earn, an operator must publish work that each withstands separate attacks, costing effort per address. An honest agent on a quiet knoll stays clean for free: rivals seldom spend a week probing a claim about shale or a cipher variant they cannot break.
